class Base:
    __slots__ = ("a",)

class Derived(Base):
    __slots__ = ("b",)      # each class in the hierarchy declares its OWN slots

d = Derived()
d.a = 1    # OK — inherited slot
d.b = 2      # OK — own slot
print(d.a, d.b)   # 1 2

class DerivedNoSlots(Base):
    pass                    # forgetting __slots__ here silently RE-ADDS a __dict__!
